natural_split: 25 calibration / 75 test source images; deterministic SHA256 order; all derivatives stay in the same split
images: 2x4, 2x16, 2x64 native-resolution crops; 8x8 and 16x16 full-frame square resizes
crop_categories: foreground-only, background-only, and boundary windows with 25-75 percent majority-mask foreground; one deterministic random window per available category and width
human_reference: Decode red annotation overlays by R-max(G,B)>128, including antialiased borders; majority of three human masks. Record sensitivity to red-dominance thresholds 64 versus 192; this decoding never thresholds the input image
seeds: One farthest-interior seed per available consensus class; background first. Same seeds for all methods; seeds never clamp the quantum state
zero_sign_convention: Foreground requires a strict correlation sign in its favor; absolute correlations <=1e-12 are numerically unresolved and receive the background label for raw IoU. Report unresolved fractions separately
calibration_objective: Mean foreground IoU of exact Gibbs correlations on 8x8 and 16x16 CALIBRATION images, averaging the two sizes equally per source; fixed tie order prefers original defaults then smaller K, alpha, threshold
held_out_comparison: Original parameters versus one frozen Gibbs-selected global recalibration; no per-test-image tuning
baselines: Seeded graph random walker: edge conductance exp(-(difference/scale)^2)+1e-6; scale=max(0.1*(image intensity q95-q05),1)

interior_controls.parameters: original only; analyze separately from boundary segmentation

reference: Exact width-bounded row transfer for every Gibbs target, verified against full enumeration and independent ladder transfer
metrics: 95 percent simultaneous sign resolution across all requested seeds/pixels at one checkpoint
synthetic_design: 5 geometries (disk, ring, two islands, narrow bridge, thin path) x 5 conditions (clean, noise20, noise60, contrast80, blur) x 2 sizes x 2 replicates; no synthetic calibration
uncertainty: Bootstrap original images, not individual crops. Sampling confidence does not include finite-sweep Gibbs bias. No claim of full quantum-state simulation for large images
follow_up: Longer and/or higher-shot confirmation may diagnose flagged cases, with parameters frozen; report them separately from the primary 500-sweep benchmark
